# nodo-mcp

> A read-only feed of savings assets, what they pay, and what it costs to borrow against them.

A neobank pays customers a rate on deposits. The cash behind those balances has to earn more than that rate. One way to earn the spread is to place cash in short-dated assets, such as government debt or private credit, and sometimes to borrow against those assets. The spread is the asset yield minus the cost of funds. It disappears if the loan passes the loan-to-value where the collateral is sold, or if the rates are no longer today's rates.

NODO does not hold the deposits. It keeps the live book a treasury or product team reads before pricing the savings rate: the assets, the spread after funding cost, and the lending desks. The book is at https://app.nodo.xyz/api/v2. This repository only reads it. Booking a loan stays on that API, under the neobank's own approval.

## Start here

- [The book, and how to connect a reader](README.md): deposits, spread, margin call, and how Claude, Codex, or Cursor connect
- [Rules for Claude](CLAUDE.md): read the book, do not book a loan
- [Rules for Codex](AGENTS.md): the same rules

## How to look something up

- [Savings assets and the spread after funding cost](skills/find-nodo-yield/SKILL.md): what an asset pays, and what is left after interest
- [Lending desks and rate history](skills/read-nodo-markets/SKILL.md): which desk takes the collateral, the loan-to-value of a margin call, and what the desk has charged

## What a caller can ask

- `list_assets`, then `get_asset`: the assets, their yield, their size, and their terms
- `list_opportunities`, then `get_opportunity`: one asset at one desk, the spread after funding cost, and the largest loan short of a margin call
- `list_markets`: the desks, narrowed by name, collateral, or currency borrowed
- `get_market_apy_history`: what a desk has paid, and what it has cost to borrow

Lists return about ten rows unless a larger page is requested. `nextOffset` marks the next page. `asOfTime` is when the figures were taken.
